content.value_statement: Video requests often need different workflows for assets, captions, animation, and rendering. HyperFrames routes each request to the right HTML-based video workflow and supporting skill.
actual_capabilities: Routes video requests to HyperFrames workflows based on input type and output goal.
Lists domain skills for composition authoring, animation, keyframes, media, CLI use, registry blocks, and Figma import.
Provides routing rules for product videos, website tours, explainers, PR videos, captions, recuts, motion graphics, music videos, slideshows, and migrations.
Defines default aspect and language assumptions before workflow selection.
Explains what to do when a matched workflow is not installed.
Documents how to check and update HyperFrames skill versions.
limitations: It routes work but does not build a finished video by itself.
It depends on separate HyperFrames workflow skills for production.
Some workflows need local media files, website access, GitHub access, or installed CLI tools.
It does not perform traditional video editing such as recolor, reframe, or footage retiming.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Promo
use_cases.description: Route a product URL, brief, or script to the product launch workflow before production starts.

use_cases.title: Select a Creator Workflow
use_cases.description: Choose the right path for captions, overlays, music videos, motion graphics, or website tours.

use_cases.title: Explain Technical Changes
use_cases.description: Route pull requests or Remotion migrations to workflows that create technical video explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Route a Basic Video Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use HyperFrames to choose the right workflow for a 60-second product promo. The product URL is [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Website Tour
prompt_templates.prompt: Route this non-commercial website into the correct HyperFrames workflow. Produce the next steps for a short site tour: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Select a Caption Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a talking-head video and need captions with the footage unchanged. Route it and list the assets needed before build.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a Mixed Video Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this brief and choose the correct HyperFrames workflow. Explain why the other workflows do not fit: [brief].

output_examples.input: A user asks for a launch video for a SaaS homepage.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the product launch workflow, confirms the product input, and leaves production to the matched workflow.

output_examples.input: A user asks to add captions to an existing MP4.
output_examples.output: The skill selects embedded captions when the footage must stay unchanged, or talking-head recut when designed overlays are needed.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a pitch deck with navigation and speaker notes.
output_examples.output: The skill routes the request to the slideshow workflow because the deliverable is an interactive deck, not a rendered video.

best_practices: Provide the main input first, such as a URL, topic, PR, script, or video file.
State the desired destination when vertical or social formatting matters.
Install the matched workflow skill before asking the agent to continue production.
anti_patterns: Do not use product launch routing for a simple website tour.
Do not choose motion graphics for narrated, multi-scene explainer videos.
Do not ask many routing questions before the matched workflow is selected.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes video and animation requests to the correct HyperFrames workflow.

faq.question: Does it render the final video?
faq.answer: No. It identifies the workflow that should handle authoring, validation, and rendering.

faq.question: When should I use product launch video?
faq.answer: Use it when the request markets a product, service, app, company site, or SaaS offer.

faq.question: When should I use website to video?
faq.answer: Use it when the goal is to show the website itself, such as a tour or showcase.

faq.question: Can it route caption and overlay work?
faq.answer: Yes. It distinguishes plain embedded captions from talking-head videos with designed graphic overlays.

faq.question: What should I provide before routing?
faq.answer: Provide the subject and input type. Useful inputs include a URL, brief, PR, topic, audio file, or video file.
